name: atelier-mcp
description: Environnement de développement du plugin WordPress Atelier MCP.

scripts.lint:php: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app --entrypoint sh wordpress:php8.2 -c 'find . -name "*.php" -not -path "./vendor/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.dev-cache/*" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l > /tmp/lint.txt; status=$?; grep -v "^No syntax errors" /tmp/lint.txt; exit $status'
